title: Tutorials for Learning VS Code in GitHub Codespaces
text: core tutorials introduce students VS Code integrated development environment. Workspace (“00-workspace”). tour workspace: bash Terminal, R Terminal, GitHub Copilot, ways run R code. Moved tutorial.helpers, whose five-minute Getting Started tutorial now handles first contact. Workflow (“01-workflow”). first tutorial Workspace: move around VS Code, use Terminal, create GitHub repo, run R scripts, make plots, commit push Git. Code (“02-code”). Introduce students VS Code writing R code simple scripts. Quarto (“03-quarto”). Demonstrate tricks working R code using VS Code, also explain Quarto documents. Antigravity (“04-antigravity”). Meet Antigravity CLI agent (agy) use create render Quarto analysis. Terminal 1 (“05-terminal-1”). First three bash Terminal tutorials: core commands, paths, output redirection. Terminal 2 (“06-terminal-2”). Command options, environment variables, looking inside files, moving files Codespace, running R Python programs. Terminal 3 (“07-terminal-3”). Wildcards, regular expressions, grep, pipes. GitHub Introduction (“08-github-1”). Explain basics Git GitHub, mostly context VS Code. GitHub Advanced (“09-github-2”). practice Git/GitHub: create repo hand gh, clone onto fresh machine, pull changes back, delete Codespace work survives GitHub. Websites 1 (“10-websites-1”). Use quarto CLI create, render, preview, publish multi-page website GitHub Pages. Websites 2 (“11-websites-2”). Build site multi-page navigation drop-menus, refactor analysis code scripts save results RDS PNG files. Devcontainers (“12-devcontainers”). Introduce devcontainers, touring pre-built Jupyter devcontainer.json building R devcontainer.json scratch. Codespace Starter (“13--codespace-starter”). Tour devcontainer.json behind codespace-starter . Devcontainer Dockerfile (“14-docker”). Read Dockerfile builds PPBDS devcontainer image. Starter (“15--starter”). Build version codespace-starter, Dockerfile, image, devcontainer.json. construction. Dotfiles (“16-dotfiles”). Build private dotfiles repo GitHub reads every time makes machine, brand new Codespace already knows Git identity. OpenRouter (“17-openrouter”). Get OpenRouter account API key, store key survives rebuild, use drive aider free cheap models. Models Money (“18-models”). Buy $10 OpenRouter credits — credit card course — call API bash R ellmer, find hundred-fold price gap free frontier models actually buys. R Data Science Analyzing US Census Data tutorials now live separate misc.tutorials package.
